summary: v43.42 backend testing: Bounce Digest (config GET/POST, preview, run-now, history), Marketplace Leaderboard (week/month/all with 5 badge tiers), and Live Server Diagnostic (status/commands/report-install allowlisted/install-reports) all validated end-to-end against public preview URL. 15/15 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: bounce_digest.py /run-now stores html_preview inside every db.bounce_digests document — payloads with hundreds of samples can bloat the collection over months. Consider storing html_preview separately or omitting on write (it can be re-rendered from stored aggregates).

bounce_digest.py /run-now iterates ALL active licenses but always uses the caller's master key check — however the caller's key is not scoped: any MS- prefix key triggers digest generation for every license in db.licenses. If multi-tenant, this leaks scope. Recommend scoping to lic.master_license_key == master_key.

bounce_digest.py _bounce_digest_daily_loop uses `pv >= '1.2.0'` string compare — will break at 1.10.0. Same pattern exists in live_diagnostic.py check #2. Use packaging.version.parse or tuple comparison.
bounce_digest.py DigestConfig.recipient_email is Optional[str] with no EmailStr validation — invalid email addresses can be persisted silently. Use pydantic.EmailStr.

bounce_digest.py /preview accepts arbitrary license_key query param (no auth on it) when X-Master-Key not provided but returns full bounce data. `lk = license_key or master_key` should require master_key.startswith('MS-') before allowing external license_key.

live_diagnostic.py /report-install has ZERO auth — any unauthenticated caller can flood db.install_reports with arbitrary payloads (any license_key string). Being in the demo-write allowlist is intentional, but there is no rate limit, no license_key existence check, and no size limit on stdout/stderr fields. Add basic validation (license_key startswith 'MS-' + exists in db.licenses) and cap field length to e.g. 100KB.
live_diagnostic.py /status queries licenses with $or on license_key AND master_license_key — but master_license_key is not indexed by default; verify index exists for tenant scale.

bounce_digest.py grew module coupling: marketplace leaderboard router lives inside bounce_digest.py despite being a separate feature. Split into routes/marketplace_leaderboard.py to keep single-responsibility.
